chapter: New Orleans bands, Louis and the Lyric
title: Hiring Louis Armstrong for the Orchard Cabaret
summary: Zutty hired Louis, Johnny St. Cyr and Yudell Wilson for the Orchard; Bootsy Hernandez, a Manuel Perez fan, loved Louis. Zutty says Louis played very well.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: And then I heard Louis was in town and I went and hired Louis Armstrong and I hired Johnny Sincere and St. Cyr Yudell Wilson.
Yudell. Yudell Wilson. Tulsa His father was a pastor in/Oklahoma.

Yes. He played the piano. Oh man, and how. And so that's when I got Louis, to come over to the Orchard. And that was just the next night, we had to open at the Orchard. And I got old Louis and Johnny St. Cyr and Yudell Wilson. And we opened up. And boy oh boy, that knocked Bootsy out. Because Bootsy was a Manuel Perez fan. He just loved Manuel Perez. But old Bootsy Hernendez boy, he loved Louis.
